question: Prime Intellect (compute/prime-intellect, compute/prime-intellect-2): the new Prime Inference API (api.pinference.ai/api/v1, OpenAI-compatible, hosted and gateway models) is not covered by any record. Does it have a free model or signup credit, and what are its rate limits?
why: https://docs.primeintellect.ai/inference/overview (capture sha256:0e9c010c968df3e31613786ca674f1734d4aa3e1dc7cb9c606c2313b85acf69d) says pricing, limits and supported features are set per model and shown in a catalog behind the signed-in dashboard; https://docs.primeintellect.ai/inference/troubleshooting.md (capture sha256:f4cea7f19deff90447d7bdb0ef989baf0fee0ddecd2b49961eee8dc16a20df53) documents an insufficient_funds error when the billed account lacks balance. Neither page states a free tier or a rate limit. A search snippet of the full docs text mentions '50 requests per 60 seconds per IP and token' (lead only, not captured). Needs the signed-in catalog or the llms-full text captured.
